title: The three-dimensional Ball–Evans approximation problem

result.label: The three-dimensional Ball–Evans approximation problem
result.statement: Resolves the three-dimensional Ball–Evans approximation problem: every W^ 1,p homeomorphism between arbitrary bounded domains in ℝ 3 , for 1 p , is a strong W^ 1,p limit of smooth diffeomorphisms onto the same target.
result.roleNote: The family's stated result in the release.
